title: Installation of the Fwd Cargo Compartment Lining Panels

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of the forward cargo compartment lining panels and the smoke detection air flow check that must be passed before the compartment is returned to service.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to install the ceiling and upper sidewall lining panels of the forward cargo compartment and to do the smoke detection air flow check.
sections.job_setup_note: Before you install the first panel, confirm that the structure behind it is clear of tools, fasteners and packaging, and that any attenuation blanket is correctly seated in the panel return. Work from the forward end aft, which is the reverse of the removal order, so that each panel overlaps the one already installed. The air flow check at the end of the task is not optional and cannot be deferred, because the compartment fire protection depends on the panel seal line.
sections.procedure: 1. Do a general visual inspection of the compartment structure and remove all foreign objects. 2. Make sure that the attenuation blankets, where fitted, are seated in the panel return along their full length. 3. Install the upper trim strip 9911DL. 4. Put the forwardmost sidewall panel D2550113609050 in position and engage the lower edge in the rail. 5. Install the blind rivets LN181986-9B in the lining rail where the illustration shows them. CAUTION: DO NOT OVER-DRIVE THE BLIND RIVETS. AN OVER-DRIVEN RIVET WILL CRACK THE PANEL EDGE AND THE PANEL MUST THEN BE REPLACED. 6. Do steps 4 and 5 again for each sidewall panel, working aft. 7. Connect the light assembly D2550118482429 to each ceiling panel and check that the lens sits flush. 8. Install the ceiling panels, working aft, and close the quick-release fasteners. 9. Install the light lenses. 10. Do a general visual inspection of the panel seal line along its full length. 11. Do the smoke detection air flow check with the flow test set. WARNING: DO NOT RELEASE THE AIRCRAFT TO SERVICE IF THE AIR FLOW CHECK IS NOT SATISFACTORY. 12. Remove the smoke detection inhibit and remove the warning notice.
sections.close_out: Confirm that the smoke detection system is restored and that the entry in the aircraft technical log is closed. Install the cargo nets. Record the air flow check result and the rivet count on the aircraft work card. If the compartment volume has changed because attenuation blankets have been added, tell the operator loading office.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Post MOD-161204 aircraft use the panel with the moulded return and the longer light standoff.

safety_precautions: Keep the smoke detection system inhibited until step 12.
Make sure that no foreign object stays behind the lining.
Use a padded trestle for every panel.
